title: Winter plan — 1 Nov to 17 Dec 2026

exams.subject: micro
exams.title: Micro MT2 — mycology IV 1–11 + DNA virology III 1–19

exams.subject: pharm
exams.title: Pharmacology semifinal — oral: drugs, core concept, A, C (18th if a slot opens)

exams.subject: immuno
exams.title: Genetics + immunology — late January slot (date to confirm)

rules: THE DAILY FLOOR is what happens even on a bad day. Until 25 Nov: Anki + one Section II topic + one pharm topic (~1¼ h). From 26 Nov: Anki + one bacteria topic + one RNA virus topic + one pharm topic (~2 h).
Anything marked TARGET is for good days. If it is skipped it slides to the next good day. Never do three to catch up — that is how the old plan broke.
Anki due reviews every day, all decks. That is the review of the midterm material — do not re-read old notes until the blurt days in December.
Micro final Monday 14 Dec, so everything micro is done by Sunday the 13th. There is no exam-week buffer before it.
Pharm semifinal is oral: drug recognition (waived only with 19+ on BOTH midterms), then one core concept, one A topic and one C topic. A blank on any one of them fails it.
List C overlaps micro: penicillins, cephalosporins, aminoglycosides, macrolides, antituberculotics, antivirals, antifungals. Learn each once, for both exams.
Pathophysiology is out of the plan until after the December exams.
Every winter date is yours to choose. Pathophys and genetics/immunology are January.

tasks.subject: micro

tasks.detail: Short night — 06:15 practice tomorrow. Just the foundation: virus structure + viroid/prion (1), propagation and productive infection (2), latent and persistent infection (3), congenital infection (4).
